name: com.chrisballam/site-search
title: ChrisBallam.com site search
description: Search and ask Chris Ballam's LDS mission, backpacking and family travel guides and photo albums.

tools.name: search_chrisballam
tools.description: Search Chris Ballam's site: first-hand LDS missionary packing lists (elder and sister), pioneer trek packing list, Coyote Gulch backpacking guide, Thailand family vacation itinerary, and ~500 dated family photo albums (2000-2026). Returns ranked pages with title, URL, type and snippet. Handles word variants and synonyms.

query.description: Words or a question, e.g. 'sister missionary shoes' or 'Chiang Mai elephant sanctuary'.

type.description: Optional: only return this kind of page.

tools.name: ask_chrisballam
tools.description: Get a short answer generated only from Chris Ballam's pages, with the source URLs it used. Use for direct questions such as 'how many suits should an elder missionary pack?'.

tools.name: get_page_markdown
tools.description: Return the clean Markdown version (index.md) of a chrisballam.com guide or hub page, e.g. https://chrisballam.com/travel/missionary/brazil/elder/. Photo album pages have no Markdown version; use the search result instead.

url.description: A https://chrisballam.com/... page URL ending in /.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Use when the user wants to ask Chris Ballam a question, send a correction or request photo use. Returns the contact page and what he answers. This tool cannot send messages: the user sends the form on the contact page.
